scope.projectSelection: Tracked projects with main.tsp and a resource-manager ruleset reference.
scope.typeSpec: Unprojected compiles with the candidate rule explicitly enabled; five reviewed historical findings are flagged, not automatically projected.
scope.swagger: Rule-level replay on checked-in files matching the saved baseline output paths and API versions, including parent service folders; not a fresh validator-engine run.
limitations: The saved baseline inventory does not include newly added output paths or versions.
The replay does not run the validator engine, reference resolution, or suppression processing.
Project, route, and category grouping does not establish semantic equivalence.
No fresh-checkout full regeneration or complete runtime dependency lock is included.
